mentions.name: ClutchTop
mentions.description: ClutchTop is an open-source desktop AI harness built with Electron, similar to the Claude Code desktop app. It provides both chat and agentic interfaces that can use different models via OpenRouter or local models, and has progressed to being used to build itself. Currently at v1.
mentions.problem: The author wants a single app where both chat and agentic interfaces can use different models via OpenRouter or local models.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ambitious: ClutchTop - an opensource ai harness (desktop app) similar to claude code desktop app built in electron. It's to the point where I've started to use the app to build the app. Still in v1 though.
